priceSnapshot.note: Price recovered from the midday 83,183 to 83,546, back above the 83,079 Sep 28 close but still capped under 83,853. 24h change is versus the OKX 24h-open of 83,509.6. Since the midday snapshot the range was 82,987-83,852.7; the whole COT day ranged 82,902.8-84,557.8.

reduceIf.confirmation: A confirmed 1H/4H close below 82,556.6 (Sep 27 low) escalates to a spot trim toward 80,588.

addIf.confirmation: A confirmed 4H close (or two 1H closes) above 84,374.2 reclaims the failed morning squeeze high and justifies a larger add.

decisionBox.changed: Midday's small DCA becomes a HOLD into the overnight gap: momentum is flat (1H/4H MACD still negative, 15m neutral), price is only ~1.3% above the 82,556.6 reduce level (inside one 2.75% daily ATR), and cash must cover the 30 USDT Oct-1 expense. Levels unchanged; a resting stop at 82,500 is now recommended because the 1H long/short ratio (1.38) still shows crowded longs. Bias tilt goes neutral (was bearish): the midday slide never reached 82,556.6 and shorts were squeezed on the bounce.

overnightRisk: Next report is ~02:00 COT. Catalysts: (1) Sep 30 is quarter-end, so rebalancing flows and the Q4/new-month open (Oct 1) can move BTC in thin Asia liquidity; (2) US 10Y at 5.24% near multi-decade highs with Fed hikes priced, and DXY up +0.18% to 101.38, a headwind for risk; (3) Middle East / US-Iran oil headlines (Brent ~96 after a sharp drop, headline-driven both ways); (4) OKX funding settles at 00:00 and 08:00 UTC with funding +0.0094% and long/short ratio 1.38, so a slide under 83,079 can cascade into the 82,900-82,556 long-liquidation zone; (5) ETF inflows have faded to +33.2M (Sep 29), so dip-buying support is thin. A resting stop under 82,556.6 is the only real overnight protection; paper wallet also has the 30 USDT expense due Oct 1.
